title: CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md: the @AGENTS.md line in _CLAUDE.md
objective: Every generated `CLAUDE.md` opens with the line `@AGENTS.md`, rendered from `lib/templates/llm/_CLAUDE.md`, so Claude Code loads `AGENTS.md` at launch in either layout: under its default a project with a `CLAUDE.md` never read `AGENTS.md`, and the template carried the pointer as prose the harness ignores. The template's paragraph that justified copying the four-rule index on the ground that `AGENTS.md` was never received moves to the past tense, and the copy and its drift test stay (issue 0598 asks whether to retire them).
